description: ETF Constituent Pull-Through (FMP-powered). For each ETF with |z|>=1.5σ, pulls top 50 holdings from FMP /stable/etf/holdings, computes per-stock implied flow pressure (daily/5d/21d) aggregated across all ETFs, joins sector/country/price-return from finviz-universe + universe.json, and classifies each stock into a flow-vs-price quadrant via cross-sectional z-score.
